_comment: Copy to apps.json (gitignored) and edit. One entry per registered app. apiKeyHashHex = sha256(rawAppToken), never the raw token. Generate token + hash on the VM: RAW=$(openssl rand -hex 24); docker compose run --rm --no-deps policy-service node dist/cli/hash-api-key.js "$RAW". The raw token goes only into the app's paymaster URL (https://paymaster.<DOMAIN>/paymaster/<RAW>). The placeholder hash below is the sha256 of nothing anyone knows, so it matches no token until replaced. Caps are per app per UTC day / lifetime, in wei. NEVER add the local-dev key here.
